dose.frequency: three times daily (levodopa 100 mg / carbidopa 25 mg)

regimens.dose_text: Initial starting dose: one tablet of carbidopa/levodopa 25/100 mg three times daily. Titrate by adding one tablet every day or every other day as needed up to a daily dosage of 8 tablets of 25/100 mg (200/800 mg/day). At least 70 to 100 mg of carbidopa daily is required to prevent peripheral dopa decarboxylation side effects.

mechanism_of_action.value: Levodopa is the metabolic precursor of dopamine that crosses the blood-brain barrier and is decarboxylated to dopamine in the striatum. Carbidopa inhibits peripheral dopa decarboxylase, increasing central levodopa availability without crossing the blood-brain barrier.
